title: A new value outside the preceding prefix
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list in a linearly ordered set, with each entry at most the next. For an index $i<\operatorname{length}(l)$ and a default value $d$, suppose either $i=0$ or the entry at index $i$ differs from the entry at index $i-1$, using $d$ for any out-of-range index. Then the entry at index $i$, again using $d$ as the default, does not occur among the first $i$ entries of $l$.
